name: qing-mao-rebirth
description: Qing Mao · Rebirth — a Reverend Insanity chapters 1-200 story world. Engine and content are split so a sequel can reuse both.

scripts.build: npm run lint:content && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node tools/build-offline.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint:content && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tests/unit/movement.test.mts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tests/unit/encounter.test.mts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tests/unit/folk.test.mts
scripts.sweep: npm run build && node tools/visual-sweep.mjs && python3 tools/contact-sheet.py
scripts.sweep:phone: npm run build && node tools/visual-sweep.mjs --phone --out sweep-phone && python3 tools/contact-sheet.py --dir sweep-phone
